_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate plus Denial-band score and soft -8% 30d leg with flat 24h make HOLD the honest call until a clear breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial; analyst supplies explicit HOLD/medium forward while narrative is non-directional measured-only
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear/greed holds 32-38 and BTC stays inside ±1.5% 24h with no funding flush or ETF-flow reversal
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear/greed breaks below 32 with accelerating downside (Panic) or reclaims above 39 with 30d momentum turning positive (Anxiety)
